qc.label_under_test: A piece partway through an extreme verdict, good or bad, before the rest of it arrives: an inner chunk of an intense judging adjective or adverb that is split into several tokens, mainly because it is written in ALL CAPS or broken by a hyphen (INCREDIBLE, FABULOUS, HORRENDOUS in caps; extra-ordinary; Russian замечательный); the opening word of a praise compound or idiom (first-rate, top-notch, world-class, state of the art, out of this world, show-stopping); and ' nothing' right after is/was opening a verdict (was nothing special, is nothing short of). Quiet on the same judging words spelled normally in lowercase (incredible, spectacular, magnificent arrive as one token), on plain superlatives (the best I have ever seen), on literal uses of the openers (the top of the hill, around the world, the state of Ohio), on ' nothing' after a comma or in literal uses (nothing left in the cupboard), and on neutral words in caps or split (RECTANGULAR, CALIFORNIA, photosynthesis).

neighbours.label: A strong verdict that is still arriving in pieces: an inner chunk of an intense judging word, good or bad, that is split into several tokens because it is written in ALL CAPS or broken by a hyphen (INCREDIBLE, HORRIBLE, WONDERFUL, TERRIFYING in caps; extra-ordinary; Russian замечательный); the middle of a vivid verdict idiom or compound (out of this world, show-stopping, state-of-the-art, mind-blowing, second to none); and ' nothing' right after is/was opening a verdict (was nothing special, is nothing short of). Quiet on the same judging words spelled normally in lowercase (incredible, magnificent, dreadful arrive as one token), on plain superlatives (the best I have ever seen), on neutral words in caps (DELIVERED, MASSACHUSETTS), on literal uses (the state of Ohio, around the world), on ' nothing' after a comma or in literal uses (nothing in the cupboard), and on the rank compounds first-rate, first-class, top-notch and top-tier.
fire: Honestly, the final episode was INCREDIBLE from start to finish.
The service at that hotel was HORRIBLE and we left a day early.
My grandmother said the soup was WONDERFUL and asked for the recipe.
The drop on that roller coaster is TERRIFYING, even for adults.
Her performance last night was extra-ordinary, the whole hall stood up.
Критики назвали этот фильм замечательный и очень смелый.
The dessert at that little bakery is out of this world.
She gave a show-stopping speech at the wedding reception.
quiet: The service at that hotel was dreadful and we left a day early.
My grandmother said the soup was magnificent and asked for the recipe.
The package was DELIVERED to the wrong address on Tuesday.
Her performance last night was the best I have ever seen.
We drove through MASSACHUSETTS on the way to visit my cousin.
The dessert at that little bakery is shipped around the world.
The lab moved to the state of Ohio last year for the students.
The hotel offered first-class rooms with a view of the bay.
